authors.name: Editorial Team
authors.bio: Our team rigorously tests privacy-focused operating systems and hardware configurations. We rely on verifiable evidence, not marketing claims.

editorial.how_we_test: We evaluate devices and OSes (like GrapheneOS and CalyxOS) based on published criteria including network traffic analysis, verifiable security properties, and attack surface reduction. We never state a security property we have not tested.
editorial.how_we_make_money: We sell a paid setup guide and a capped line of pre-configured hardware. We also earn affiliate commissions (1-4%) on some recommendations, but this does not drive our business.
editorial.corrections: We correct factual errors promptly and transparently. If a claim about a device's privacy is proven false, we update the evaluation and note the change.
